- 16:21 MT started. Step 1 diagnose opening-bar batch timing, step 2 deploy trunk to trader-dev.

## Step 1: diagnose (deployed code, read-only, no DB writes) — 16:26 MT

Script: scratch LIVE-0928/diag_openbars.py piped to docker exec -i trader-dev python -. Real QuestradeClient via runtime.questrade_client(build_core()), 543 FiveMinutes requests (universe_snapshots 2026-09-28, open 13:30Z), no deadline, httpx get and _pause_after_429 wrapped.

Run A (alone, after close): total 28.01 s. 546 HTTP responses: 543 x 200, 3 x 429 (all at t=1.2 s). Latency p50 0.104 s, p95 0.119 s, max 0.489 s. X-RateLimit-Remaining 14997 -> 14454 (hourly budget), min 0 (on the 429s). Reset at each 429: +0.4 s. Pause set 0.5 s each, union paused 0.54 s. 543/543 bars.

Run B (same batch + a second client polling quotes for 100 ids at ~3 rps, 82 calls): total 42.15 s. 543 x 200, 38 x 429 (two every ~2 s through the run). Latency p50 0.105, p95 0.119, max 0.278. Reset at each 429: +0.0..0.1 s, pause set 0.5 s each (the 0.5*2**attempt floor, not the Reset), sum 20.5 s, union paused 12.85 s.

Worker load at 9:35: none concurrent. Worker.step awaits _fire_due (the orb_open scan) before _poll, so no quote poll overlaps the batch; poll_quotes asks only for working-order symbols (none before the scan), 1 call per 100 ids every quote_poll_seconds=2 s. API calls Questrade only for position detail (no positions). Container logs 13:33-13:37Z show only the timeout. Job event:orb_open 13:35:05.41 -> 13:35:50.65Z (45.2 s, all in candles_many). Token was fresh (preopen 13:20Z), no refresh in the window.

Root cause: the batch runs at exactly Questrade's 20 req/s market limit (27.2 s pacing floor, 17.8 s slack in 45 s). Questrade 429s even at nominal pacing, and each 429 pauses the whole bucket >= 0.5 s (floor 0.5*2**attempt, doubling on retries) although Reset says 0.0-0.4 s, and the paused waiters lose their slots and re-queue at the tail. So every 429 costs ~0.34 s of wall time (12.85 s / 38). Any extra load on the per-second window (open-time arrival jitter at peak Questrade load, or another caller of the same account) turns 3 x 429 into ~50+ x 429 and pushes the batch past 45 s: 3 rps of extra load alone took it from 28 s to 42 s. Fix direction (not done here): pace the batch below the limit (e.g. 15-17 rps), honour Reset (pause = max(reset_delta, small) not a 0.5 s floor), and keep the partial set at the deadline (6324d34, being deployed now).
